identity.name: Sandwich Doctorate Scholarship at Foreign Higher Education Institutions
identity.issuing_authority: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz - Coordenação de Ensino, with CAPES

records.description: Fiocruz Edital CG nº 01/2026 funds a research stay (doutorado sanduíche) abroad for Fiocruz doctoral students who are enrolled in Fiocruz postgraduate programmes that belong to Rede CAPES Global. The stay is used to develop research at a foreign higher education institution under the Temas Estratégicos of the strategic areas; the student returns to Brazil afterwards to finish and defend the thesis at Fiocruz. The call is run under Programa CAPES-Global.Edu (CAPES Edital nº 13/2025) and overseas activities are scheduled to start in September and October 2027.

eligibility: Students enrolled in Fiocruz postgraduate programmes registered as students on the CAPES Sucupira platform
Programme must be linked to the Temas Estratégicos listed in Anexo I of the CAPES Edital nº 13/2025
Both Brazil-based and foreign applicants may apply, but only for one of the up to five editais
benefits: Financing of a research stay at a foreign higher education institution
Activities abroad expected to start between September and October 2027
selection_criteria: Merit and strategic fit of the overseas research stay with the Rede CAPES Global Temas Estratégicos (Anexo I)
official.application_process: Application is made exclusively through the electronic form published on the edited page; first-time users must register before applying. Only one of the up to five editais of the CG Fiocruz 01/2026 call may be applied to, and registering for more than one leads to automatic cancellation.
key_dates: Expected start of overseas activities: September and October 2027

deadlines.label: Submission deadline
deadlines.note: The edital page header lists 15/12/2026 17:00 as the overall close of the notice, while the electronic form window is published as 15/09/2026 10:01 to 23/10/2026 16:00. The form deadline is the operative one for applicants.

verification.deadline_note: No fixed application cycle date; dates are per-call (Edital CG Fiocruz nº 01/2026). The overall edital closes 15/12/2026 17:00.
verification.application_cycle: Edital CG Fiocruz nº 01/2026 (Doutorado Sanduíche no Exterior), Programa CAPES-Global.Edu, CAPES Edital nº 13/2025; overseas activities from September-October 2027
verification.tuition_coverage_note: Not stated. The notice publishes no values for tuition, living costs, travel or insurance.
verification.status_note: Status computed at research time (10 October 2026). The electronic form is open from 15 September 2026 and closes on 23 October 2026 at 16:00 Brasília time, so the call is currently OPEN.

applicant_utility.description: Fiocruz's sandwich doctorate call is a single-window, single-shot process: you apply through one electronic form on the editais portal, and registering for more than one of the five editais in the same call automatically cancels your application. The practical decision you must make before 23 October 2026 at 16:00 Brasília time is which call (which Anexo V committee area) to target, because you cannot hedge.
eligibility_tips: Check your programme against Anexo I before writing anything: only Fiocruz postgraduate programmes linked to Rede CAPES Global Temas Estratégicos are eligible, and you must be registered as a student on the CAPES Sucupira platform.
Your profile as a Brazil-based or foreign applicant does not restrict which edital you choose, but you still get only one attempt across the whole 01/2026 call.
application_tips: Create the portal account early. The form only opens for first-time users after registration, and the window closes on a hard date and time (23/10/2026 16:00 Brasília), not at midnight.
Applications, results and appeals are published exclusively on the editais page - do not rely on email notifications, so check the page after the result is posted and respect the appeal deadline.

Write the project defence around Anexo V (developmental objectives of the strategic area) and the overseas host's ability to deliver it; the stay must be credible as a sandwich period abroad with a return to Fiocruz to finish and defend the thesis.
Start planning travel, visas and leaving work at home now: activities abroad are scheduled to begin in September and October 2027, which leaves roughly a year between the application and departure.
mistakes_to_avoid: Registering for more than one edital in the 01/2026 call, which cancels your application automatically.
Assuming the edital's closing date (15/12/2026 17:00) is the submission deadline - the form itself shuts on 23/10/2026 at 16:00 Brasília.
Applying without confirming that your own postgraduate programme is listed among those linked to the Temas Estratégicos in Anexo I.
Waiting for a personal result notice: results and appeals are posted only on the editais page.
applicant_utility.deadline_notes: Mark two dates: 23 October 2026 at 16:00 Brasília time for the submission, and 15 December 2026 17:00 for the overall close of the notice, after which the appeal stage runs. Questions go to rede.capesglobal@fiocruz.br.
